headline: Pull the batteries: TALK ME DOWN's back plate gets a hand
lede: THE DRAIN is live — flip to the maintenance plate and A pulls a battery out into an in-hand pocket, one press one action, and the round-5 D6 rule spends the trick: the page demands PULL, DIAL the number LEFT, then SET. The same shift made FloorBoss departures physical — parcels stage on the dock pad and trucks haul them box by box.

notes.text: #1909 THE DRAIN shipped via PR #1914: edge-triggered pull/push verb, D6 pull-first rule, live battery counts (the page says COUNT, never a frozen digit), and the pocket rides hash, sim state and the network snapshot — WATCH drives it with the same brain.

#1911 FLOOR BOSS load-out shipped: parcels stage on the pad (cap 3), the manager's call lands when the pad fills or the oldest parcel ages out, and departures physically carry the boxes — reported honestly, +N when the trailer caps out.

Main's nightly red was a stale source pin, not broken code: watchcheck pinned TMD's seat key to a line layout that #1889 had grown. Re-pinned behaviorally, the nightly on the current tip came back GREEN — the merge freeze lifted the same afternoon.

Harness law from the shift: several lanes and one GitHub token means gh run watch burns the API quota — single-shot queries, sleep to reset, and probe production with curl for source-string signatures, never hashes.
